features.name: Free Spins

features.description: Santa symbol adds to a progressive trail above the reel window with 4 stages that modify reels by removing lower paying symbols and award 5 extra spins.

specs.description: Santa's Winning Wishlist is a 20 line, 5 reel Christmas-themed slot featuring free spins with expanding Santa wilds and a progressive trail system. The trail removes lower paying symbols and awards extra spins as players progress through 4 stages during the bonus round.

functional_symbols.name: Santa WILD
functional_symbols.description: Expands to fill the whole reel and substitutes for all symbols except BONUS symbols, also adds to progressive trail

functional_symbols.name: BONUS

features.name: Multiplier Wild
features.description: Wild symbols carry variable multiplier values (1x, 2x, 3x) that multiply wins in combinations they participate in. Multiple wilds can stack for combined multiplier effects.

features.name: Pick Bonus
features.description: Players pick from 12 facedown items to reveal jackpot icons. Matching 3 items awards the corresponding jackpot.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.description: 4-tier fixed jackpot system awarded through the Jackpot Pick Game. Prizes are scaled by the total bet.

features.name: Persistence
features.description: All Wild symbols that land on paylines are collected across base game spins. Any collected Wild could trigger the Jackpot Pick feature on subsequent spins.
characteristics: Accumulated wilds can trigger jackpot feature

jackpot_structure.structure: 4-tier fixed jackpots scaled by total bet
